fee_notes: Royalty is a flat-fee structure (not a % of gross sales): $2,500/month fixed component plus 25 basis points per completed transaction per month. Royalty begins in month 7 (or month 8 if franchise agreement signed on or after the 15th of the month). Royalty increases by $250/month per loan originator beyond 7. Franchisor may increase the Fixed Royalty Component by up to 10% annually beginning 12 months after opening. Marketing Fund fee of $350/month is embedded within (allocated from) the $2,500 Fixed Royalty Component for the primary Office — no separate marketing fee charged. Branch Offices pay a separate $350/month Branch Office Marketing Fund Fee. Franchisee must also spend at least $200/month on local advertising. Branch Royalty Fee is $1,550/month plus $250 per Branch Loan Originator. wemlo processing services fee: $825 per closed loan. Transfer fee: $2,500 per franchise agreement. Renewal fee: 50% of then-current initial franchise fee. Branch Office Renewal Fee: $1,000. Holdover Fee: $1,500/month per Office; $400/month per Branch Office. De-identification Fee: $500/day. Convention Fee: $100–$500 per person. Loan Data Export Fee: $250/hour or $2,000 per export.
